title: docs(pm-dispatch): route card threads by size and shape; p1 and security set order only
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
Fixes #35784
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuEoKvgs2TW7hc47KRGVnwtY)_

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Rule-change: ruled
Ruling-ref: 7033659866 — the maintainer's choice 「只看大小,p1 只管先后」 on a decision card in the project's cost-review thread, 2026-11-20T07:44:37Z, after asking 「p1，安全卡只是优先级，不代表复杂度，为什么一定要不进区？」 (07:42:03Z); transcribed as the ruling record on the card

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感;车队内部:小的 p1 卡不再单开线程、不再付一次全新克隆和整份重读的起步成本,大卡和需保密的安全卡照旧。
- 为什么做:你裁定开不开线程只看卡的大小和形态,p1 只管先后;派发技能原文把所有 p1 与安全卡一律单开线程,与裁决相左。
- 出错会怎样:只影响派发路由的文字,最坏是某张中卡该开线程却进了区或留在席内,随时可整段撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。这是照你的裁决抄写的受管规则文本,达档 L2 审核已核对为 `ruled`,由席位落地,不需要你再批。

## What changes

Two governed skill files under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/`, internal only (nothing publishes).

**Routing (the ruled change)**

1. `references/dispatch-runbook.md`, card-thread section, first line.
   - Before: `` - 席位会话是项目线程(载 coordinator 通道工具)⇒ M 及以上、p1、`security` 卡一卡一线程。 ``
   - After: `` - 席位会话是项目线程(载 coordinator 通道工具)⇒ M 卡有合适区进区,无则一卡一线程;p1、`security` 只定先后,⛔ 单凭它们不开线程。 ``
2. `references/dispatch-runbook.md`, the S-card line.
   - Before: `` - S 级机械卡留席内 `mode:subagent`:开线程要重新克隆、重读 `os-dev.md`,起步成本不值。 ``
   - After: `` - S 级机械卡留席内或进区 `mode:subagent`:开线程要重新克隆、重读 `os-dev.md`,起步成本不值。 ``
3. `SKILL.md`, the `mode:` row of the entry table (line 69), third column.
   - Before: `` 按卡分流:S+M ⇒ `subagent`,`cloud` 只留 L/XL 等保留面;席位是项目线程时 M 及以上、p1、`security` 一律 `thread`;大卡判据照 `dispatch-runbook.md` 卡线程节 ``
   - After: `` 按卡分流:S+M ⇒ `subagent`,`cloud` 只留 L/XL 等保留面;席位是项目线程时大卡与无合适区的 M 卡 `thread`,p1、`security` 只定先后;判据照 `dispatch-runbook.md` 卡线程节 ``

Unchanged on purpose, so they read exactly as before: the big-card line (`大卡同上,先于下行,分区亦然,修复轮随卡;大卡 = L/XL,或欠全量验证 …,或改契约 …`; its 同上 now refers to the 一卡一线程 that the new first line still states) and the disclosure-discipline line (`` 披露纪律卡(私密细节不得离开席位会话)也留席内,认领写明;卡线程照计 `batch`。 ``).

**Cut list (bytes paid by deleting restatements; each fact keeps a home)**

| # | File | Cut text | Where the fact still lives |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `dispatch-runbook.md` (thread-review line) | `:请审是席位交棒` | `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` rule 2 (`交棒归席位`), which every card thread reads; AGENTS.md Multi-agent discipline, claim paragraph (hand-over is the seat's) |
| 2 | `dispatch-runbook.md` (branch line) | `` 分支约定仍是 `claude/issue-N-SLUG`; `` | AGENTS.md Multi-agent discipline §2 (branch named `claude/issue-N-SLUG`); `os-dev.md` rule 1 (the `git worktree add … -b claude/issue-N-SLUG` recipe) |
| 3 | `SKILL.md` (communication invariants) | `裁决引文照抄不译;` | AGENTS.md Communication (引用中文裁决时保持原文、不翻译), which outranks SKILL.md; SKILL.md keeps 裁决引文 as one of the three Chinese channels on the line above |
| 4 | `dispatch-runbook.md` (new first line, own wording) | dropped `即` from a draft `有合适区即进区` | wording only, no fact |

(`N` and `SLUG` stand for the angle-bracket placeholders, spelled out so the body sanitizer keeps them.)

**Ratchet readings** (`node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`; no ceiling or pin row touched)

| File | Before (bytes / ceiling / headroom) | After (bytes / ceiling / headroom) |
|---|---|---|
| `SKILL.md` | 33872 / 33872 / 0 | 33863 / 33872 / 9 |
| `references/dispatch-runbook.md` | 20070 / 20070 / 0 | 20067 / 20070 / 3 |
| `SKILL.md` widest table row | 341 / pin 341 | 341 / pin 341 (the `mode:` row went 256 → 272 bytes, still under the widest row) |

Sweep for other p1 or `security` → `mode:thread` ties, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` plus `AGENTS.md` and `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` read-only: none besides the two lines changed. Read and left alone: `coordinator.md` §3 (`p0/p1 先` is ordering of thread opening, not a reason to open one); `area-lease.md` (`p0/p1 插队` and `先` are ordering; the 留道 line hands `安全` cards out of an area to the seat, which is not a thread route and is a file of open PR #35740); `execution-duties.md` (`有 p1 则 p1 为首` is fold ordering; its `S 级机械 + M ⇒ mode:subagent` line agrees with the new text).

## Tests

Text-only change to two internal skill files; no package, no test target. Gates below.

## Acceptance notes

- No changeset: `.claude/**` is on the fast path of files that publish nothing; `skip-changeset` rides this create.
- `.claude/**` is governed (Tier S on a `Rule-change: ruled` record): this PR stays draft for the seat's L2 record, which must read `Rule-change-verified: ruled`.

## Verification
